interview.secured: A day secured means you've completed the challenge requirement for that day and it's locked in.
interview.freeze: A freeze is a one-time pass that covers a missed day, available after earning a 7-day streak in Standard mode.
interview.selfReported: The app never explained what 'Self-reported' means on a task.
interview.tomorrow: 7 - The challenge format is engaging and the accountability levels give flexibility, but I'd need to see how the community features work to be fully hooked.
